hostname.description: The local hostname of the agent node. Defaults to system FQDN if omitted, but explicit setting is safer for template rendering.

server.description: The DNS hostname or IP address of the Puppet Master server.

server_port.description: The port number the Puppet Master listens on for agent connections.

logdir.description: The directory where Puppet agent logs are stored.

rundir.description: The directory where Puppet agent runtime state files (pids, etc.) are stored.

localfile.description: Path to a local file containing configuration settings specific to this node.

debug.description: Enables debug-level logging, which is very verbose and useful for troubleshooting.

verbose.description: Enables verbose logging, showing more detail than standard logs but less than debug.

runinterval.description: The interval in seconds between automatic agent runs.

environment.description: The Puppet environment this agent should use (e.g., production, development).

factsource.description: The URI from which the agent fetches facts.

storeconfigs.description: Deprecated in newer versions but kept for compatibility; controls whether to send configuration data back to the master.

storeconfigs_backend.description: The backend service to store configuration data in (e.g., puppetdb, yaml).

puppetdb_server.description: The URL of the PuppetDB server if storeconfigs_backend is set to puppetdb.

timeout.description: The timeout in seconds for various agent operations.

pluginsync.description: Whether the agent should download custom plugins and modules from the master.

certname.description: The unique certificate name for this agent. Usually matches the hostname.
